unresolved.work_boundary: The retained CCEL member names The Fountain of Life and contains a main division with 42 sermons, front matter, a dedicatory address, reader's address, and indexes. The complete member is routed without claiming that it equals the catalog work boundary.
unresolved.textual_form_and_translator: The retained header records English (eng) but no translator or specific translation/revision. Do not infer one.
unresolved.edition_and_publication_history: The retained title page records first publication in 1820 and reprints in 1968 and 1982. This does not establish the edition or the original composition/publication date; the legacy config's 1671 assertion is not adopted.
unresolved.parts: The member has one main division with 42 ordered sermon divisions plus front matter and indexes. No volume/part map beyond these source-native divisions is asserted.
unresolved.witness_claim: Only the exact retained CCEL ThML member is bound. The print transcription witness, collation, and proofreading history are unknown.
unresolved.source_quality: The electronic description says Flavel lived in the 15th century, an apparent source-supplied error. Preserve the statement as evidence; do not correct the retained source.
unresolved.rights_clearance: The CCEL permission record allows parsing ThML/XML and specifies attribution and a formatting-sale restriction. The empty source DC.Rights field and parse permission do not establish publication rights clearance.
